selection_rule: All ebook IDs of bookshelf 20 at snapshot time, sorted ascending by numeric ebook ID, first 100.
preprocessing: UTF-8 decode, CRLF->LF, standard PG '*** START OF ... ***' / '*** END OF ... ***' header and footer blocks removed, body stripped of leading/trailing newlines, trailing newline added.

tokenizer.trained_on: pinned corpus snapshot (manifest books, manifest order)
